label: AFFECTION

points.heading: Be curious about him again
points.body: Attraction often fades when we stop expecting anything new. Ask about something you think you already know.
points.panel: “What did you want to be when you were a kid?”

points.heading: Notice out loud
points.body: Most of what we admire in a partner goes unsaid for years.
points.panel: “I love watching you with the kids.”

points.heading: Bring back a little play
points.body: Teasing, a silly text, an inside joke from early on.
points.panel: Send him a message that only he would understand.

points.heading: Let him see you light up
points.body: Time spent on what you love brings back the version of you he fell for.
points.panel: Tell him about something that excited you this week.

resource.name: His Secret Obsession
resource.covers: Ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection.

caption:
The spark rarely disappears all at once. It gets buried under routines, schedules, and years of being busy together.

These four small habits help bring it back to the surface. If you’d like ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how another person will feel.

Follow @spotseason for more small steps.
